# Set Up
This page provides a sample IP monitoring report generated using the `gsm.kri` package. Expand the "Setup" section below to see the code used to generate the report. Or scroll down for the standard report output.

<details>
<summary>Setup</summary>

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(gsm.core)
library(gsm.mapping)
library(gsm.kri)

# --- Step 1: Map the subject, study completion and IP non-starter data ------
mappings_wf <- MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = c("SUBJ", "STUDCOMP", "IPNS"),
  strPath = "workflow/1_mappings",
  strPackage = "gsm.mapping",
  bExact = TRUE
)
lRaw <- Ingest(gsm.core::lSource, CombineSpecs(mappings_wf))
lMapped <- RunWorkflows(mappings_wf, lRaw)

# --- Step 2: Pick "today" -----------------------------------------------------
# The bundled data stops years before its reporting snapshots, so "today" is its
# own as-of date, recovered from the not-dosed participants' day counts.
dSnapshotDate <- with(
  lMapped$Mapped_IPNS,
  max(drv_enrollment_dt + drv_days_lapsed_since_enrl - 1, na.rm = TRUE)
)

lListings <- list(
  Mapped_IPNS = lMapped$Mapped_IPNS,
  Mapped_SUBJ = lMapped$Mapped_SUBJ,
  Mapped_STUDCOMP = lMapped$Mapped_STUDCOMP
)
```

</details>

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
## Render example report inline using knit_child
child_env <- list2env(
  list(
    params = list(
      dfResults = NULL,
      lListings = lListings,
      dSnapshotDate = dSnapshotDate
    )
  ),
  parent = environment()
)
report_ip_compliance <- knitr::knit_child(
  system.file("report", "Report_IPCompliance.Rmd", package = "gsm.kri"),
  envir = child_env,
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(report_ip_compliance, sep = "\n")
```
